name: Tapetide
description: Official MCP server for Tapetide, Indian stock market (NSE and BSE) research covering about 8,200 listed stocks. 55 tools for live quotes, financials, technicals, a 326-ratio fundamental screener and a technical screener, analyst ratings and forecasts, shareholding, FII/DII flows, option chains and IV, index performance, parsed filings (annual reports, concall transcripts), IPOs, bulk and block deals, and portfolio and watchlist tracking.

TAPETIDE_TOKEN.description: Tapetide personal token from https://tapetide.com/settings/tokens (free plan available). Without it the server starts and lists tools, but tool calls require the token.
